The interior angles of an $n$-gon sum to $(n-2)\cdot 180^\circ$. The missing angle $x$ must satisfy $0^\circ < x < 180^\circ$ because the polygon is convex. So $(n-2)\cdot 180$ is the smallest multiple of $180$ that is greater than $1070$.

Since $1070/180 \approx 5.94$, we get $(n-2)\cdot 180 = 1080$, so $n-2 = 6$ and $n = 8$.

The missing angle is then $1080^\circ - 1070^\circ = 10^\circ$, which is valid for a convex polygon.

ANSWER: 8
